verdict.rationale: ReadMe's AI Agent/Inline AI supports prompt-driven drafting and editing (readme-docs-18, readme-docs-19), and the GitHub AI Writer watches PRs and proposes doc updates when code changes (readme-docs-8), with Reviews providing an approval/change-request-like workflow (readme-docs-12, readme-docs-27) tied to bi-directional GitHub/GitLab sync (readme-docs-11, readme-docs-26). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a schedule/cron-triggered AI drafting run, and confirmation that AI Writer or Agent output is packaged as a formal 'change request'/PR object rather than just a suggested edit inside ReadMe.
